step1_analysis.description: A cross-coupled LC oscillator core with source-follower feedback and tail current tuning. It forms half of a quadrature VCO when coupled with an identical core.

paper_reference.title: A 28-GHz Monolithic Integrated Quadrature Oscillator in SiGe Bipolar Technology

sky130_expected.calculation: f = 1 / (2*pi*sqrt(L*C)). With L=1nH and C=100fF (added in testbench), f ~ 15.9 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the chosen tank inductor and capacitor values in the testbench, as well as parasitic capacitances of the SKY130 MOSFETs.

output_power.description: RF output power delivered to a 50-ohm load.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = Vrms^2 / 50. For a 1Vpp swing, Vrms = 0.35V, P = 2.5mW = 4 dBm.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Lower supply voltage (1.8V vs 5V) significantly reduces the maximum output voltage swing and thus the output power compared to the paper.

phase_noise.description: Single-sideband phase noise at a specific offset frequency (e.g., 1 MHz).

sky130_expected.calculation: Typical CMOS LC VCO phase noise at ~15GHz is around -90 to -100 dBc/Hz @ 1MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: CMOS typically has worse 1/f noise than SiGe HBTs, but the lower oscillation frequency in this testbench might compensate slightly.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the oscillator.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = VDD * I_total. With VDD=1.8V and I_total ~ 15mA, P = 27 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scaled down due to the lower supply voltage (1.8V) in the SKY130 process.

tuning_range.description: The range of frequencies over which the VCO can be tuned.

sky130_expected.calculation: Typically 10-20% of the center frequency for LC VCOs.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the varactor tuning ratio, which is not explicitly modeled in this fixed-C testbench.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure oscillation frequency, output power, and DC power consumption.
step3_testbench.spice:
* QVCO Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_core=10u L_core=0.15u
.param W_tail=10u W_bias=5u W_buf=10u W_ef=10u

* Modified DUT (BJTs mapped to SKY130 MOSFETs, missing inductor values added)
XM1 N14 OUTN N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W='W_core' L='L_core'
XM2 N8 N8 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W='W_bias' L='L_core'
R2 OUT_I_Q GND 50
R1 N0 TUNE1 1k
R3 OUTN GND 1k
R4 N5 GND 100
R5 N10 GND 100
R6 OUT GND 1k
R7 N3 GND 100
R8 N4 N15 100
R9 OUTN_I_Q GND 50
R10 N12 GND 100
R11 N11 N15 100
R12 VCC N8 1k
XM3 N1 N8 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W='W_tail' L='L_core'
XM4 N1 N0 N12 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W='W_tail' L='L_core'
XM5 N16 OUT N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W='W_core' L='L_core'
XM6 N1 N0 N11 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W='W_tail' L='L_core'
XM7 N14 INN N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W='W_core' L='L_core'
XM8 VCC OUT OUT_I_Q GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W='W_buf' L='L_core'
XM9 N1 N8 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W='W_tail' L='L_core'
XM10 N0 N0 N10 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W='W_bias' L='L_core'
XM11 VCC OUTN OUTN_I_Q GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W='W_buf' L='L_core'
XM12 N16 IN N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W='W_core' L='L_core'
L1 VCC N14 1n
L2 VCC N16 1n
XM13 VCC VCC VCC VCC sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W='W_bias' L='L_core'
XM14 VCC N16 OUTN GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W='W_ef' L='L_core'
XM15 VCC N14 OUT GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W='W_ef' L='L_core'

* Fixes for floating nodes and missing tank capacitors
VN15 N15 0 0
C1 N14 GND 100f
C2 N16 GND 100f

* Sources
VVCC VCC 0 DC 1.8
VTUNE TUNE1 0 DC 1.8
VINN INN 0 DC 0.9
VIN IN 0 DC 0.9

* Initial conditions to kickstart oscillation
.ic v(N14)=1.8 v(N16)=0

.control
  tran 1p 5n
  
  * Measure oscillation frequency (Tank node oscillates around VDD)
  meas tran t1 trig v(N14) val=1.8 rise=10 targ v(N14) val=1.8 rise=11
  let freq = 1 / t1
  print freq
  
  * Measure output power (dBm) into 50 ohms
  meas tran vmax max v(OUT_I_Q) from=2n to=5n
  meas tran vmin min v(OUT_I_Q) from=2n to=5n
  let vpp = vmax - vmin
  let pwr_w = (vpp * vpp) / 400
  let pwr_dbm = 10 * log10(pwr_w * 1000)
  print pwr_dbm
  
  * Measure power consumption
  op
  let power = -i(VVCC) * 1.8
  print power
  
  quit
.endc
